disqualifier.note: Independently observed numeric-vs-nonnumeric facts about the two prerelease identifiers. Combined-true is the both-numeric compare path; TF/FT/FF each have their own branch, so all four combinations are legal.

Independent slug-edge filters in SlugChecks. A value may fail leading, trailing, both, or neither; combined-true is the pass path for both edges and the filter group ANDs them with the other hyphen rules.
Independent threshold predicates over one percentage. Combined-true is numerically impossible and nothing stores or matches a bit vector; readers call each helper separately.
